newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-MARATHON RUNNER BANNED FOR FOUR YEARS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MARATHON RUNNER BANNED FOR FOUR YEARS.

text.p: South African marathon runner Desmond Witbooi has been banned for four years after testing positive for an anabolic steroid, Athletics South Africa announced on Tuesday.
Witbooi, 24, failed a drugs test after finishing fifth in February's Cape Town marathon. He represented South Africa at the 1996 African Marathon Championships.
